notes.title: V0.4.3.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where item spawning wasn't drawing from all pools like it should have been.

notes.title: V0.4.3 Patch Update
notes.notes:
-- Changes --
-- Bonfires have a 1/3 chance of spawning in shop or blacksmith room.
-- Updated floor texture for fire floor.
-- Added red rocks which spawn hearts and blue rocks which spawn mana stars when destroyed by bombs.
-- Added Medallion of Blizzards active item, which freezes all enemies in the room.
-- Added Medallion of Death active item, which casts instant death on all enemies in the room.
-- Added Medallion of Petrification active item, which petrifies all enemies in the room.
-- Added Medallion of Flames active item, which burns all enemies in the room.
-- Added Amulet of Secrets passive item, which automatically opens secret and super secret rooms.
-- Add the Fairy Symbol passive item that guarantees a fairy fountain room will spawn.
-- Add the Demon Symbol passive item that guarantees a demon room will spawn.
-- Added Crystal Rose passive item, which grants curse immunity.
-- Added border for passive inventory on game screen.
-- Added room name to UI.
-- Added a couple normal room variations.
-- Hint and Psychic rooms can't spawn on the same floor anymore.
-- Added Silver Chest that spawns more pickups than brown chests.
-- Added Gold Chest that always spawns an item.

notes.title: V0.4.2 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Happy new year! Here's the V0.4.2 update:

-- Changes --

 Added 5% chance for treasure room to spawn two items.
 Added 5% chance for boss room to spawn two items.
 Added 5% chance for secret room to spawn two items (if it spawns an item).
 Added 5% chance for super secret room to spawn two items (if it spawns an item).
 Added hint room (5% chance to spawn). In the future, this room will give you hints to figure out secrets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/68b4c1f9100dd52be41183acbb25cee66f537fae.png
 Added psychic reading shop room (5% chance to spawn). This room will sell certain items for revealing secrets such as maps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/2c3722762461681d8957697ea979809b30f4e713.png
 Added minotaur statues to fire floor.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/27d300f16fd6ba18336e593d2048c0e488111bac.png
 Added border around pause menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/e2c598e1c7f5669f06ef4425832b3a452ea647fd.png
 Added gravestones as a block item to the forest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/8370234677331dacc44f7bfae3c447903b344de5.png
 Added red orb passive item that spawns an extra treasure room per floor.
 Added blue orb passive item that spawns two secret rooms per floor.
 Added green orb passive item that spawns an extra shop per floor.
 Added purple orb passive item that spawns two super secret room per floor.
 Blood and bone room generation chance reduced to 50% for odd numbered floors.
 Battle room generation chance reduced to 50% for even numbered floors.
 Added name of floor underneath floor number; shrank UI of floor number.
 Fixed the item count.
 Added Curse of the Labyrinth, which has a 5% chance to trigger and increases the size of a floor to around double.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/94646ca341681782d4a15b84878c738a978cc5ac.png
 Added Curse of the Lost, which has a 1% chance to trigger and hides the map for the floor.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/1bc8d1ffbdef2434286801257c290a2ea2efa50b.png


-- Bug fixes --

 Fixed a bug where the boss music would keep playing after the wind floor boss if the castle had been unlocked.


I'm aware that there's some annoying bugs present like the fact that shooting your weapon against the wall in certain directions won't let your weapon come out properly, and that there's a bias for bombs destroying blocks in certain directions, where laying a bomb from the top and/or left of blocks destroys more blocks than from the bottom and/or right of blocks. I'll try to get them addressed next update. I have a tendency to prioritize new content over bug fixes, but I realize those are some annoying bugs. There's other bugs too like with floor generation but those are the most prevalent.

Thanks for the support and have a great day!
- Elias

notes.title: V0.4.1 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Apologies for the long break between updates. I was feeling some burnout from indie development and I had to step away for a time. I'll try to communicate better in the future if I take a hiatus.

Without further ado, here's the patch notes for V0.4.1. Note that is a very small update, no gameplay changes, just updating some menu stuff.

-- Changes --
-- Updated the bestiary page. In the future, you'll be able to get information about each enemy, such as elemental resistances/weaknesses, how many times you've killed each one, and more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/861d1efa973da880e75abf553481860a6a65ab28.jpg

-- Updated the endings page. In the future, you'll be able to rewatch endings that you unlock.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/87d8f9119878a65a2051c1d9fe23f330e2d99a90.jpg

-- Updated the items unlocked page. In the future, you'll be able to look at each item you unlock individually. You'll also get a hint for items you haven't unlocked yet.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/cbafb10782d1b64e81c77c24642f8e9d9cf6faf5.jpg

-- Updated the secrets page. This will be for runs you cleared, challenges completed or various other goals. This will match the achievements you'll get in the future.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957785/c3343d20360e579be2a257a84d0ed02e12b213ef.jpg

-- Bug fixes --
-- Fixed a bug where the 'Challenges' screen still said 'Coming soon' even though the 'Lost' challenge is available.
-- Fixed a bug where the player was able to select 'Challenges' that weren't available yet.

That's all I have for today. The next update won't take as long and will have more planned. I plan to fix some common issues such as some attacks not working in certain scenarios or bomb explosions not destroying blocks around them evenly. Thanks and have a great day!

- Elias

notes.title: V0.3.9 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope your day is going well. I apologize for this patch taking so long to get released. After releasing the game to early access back in May and knocking out some quick hotfixes, I found that I needed to take a lengthy break of time afterwards. Mystic Labyrinth took me roughly 10 months to get to the initial launch, which for me is a long time to work on one game. I just had to get away for a time afterwards. But! Now I'm completely recharged and ready to deliver some high quality updates your way :) Future updates will not take as long in general barring some extenuating circumstances.

This update concentrates mostly on updating and adding some graphics, and the addition of two new rooms, the Blood and Bone room, and the Battle room. I've gotten some feedback that the game is too easy and doesn't get harder on later floors, and that also there are only two bosses. They are absolutely correct! I've been thinking on what new bosses to add in as well as ways to make the game scale in difficulty, so that you will be challenged more on later floors. For starters, you will take a full heart of damage from B5 onwards (the first water floor), but there will be more things to come on that front in the future.

Speaking of the future, I've been thinking more and more about making a roadmap for you all to see what is planned for future builds. It'll be flexible to a point, that way if I'm hearing a lot from people that they want to see certain things, I can look into incorporating them.

Without further adieu, here are the changes and bug fixes:

Changes

 Blood & Bone rooms have been added. They have spiked doors that hurt you when you enter and leave them. They contain item pickups and the spikes can be destroyed with Spike Breaker armor. Currently spawns every odd numbered floor.
 Battle rooms have been added. They have monster spawners and an item inside. Currently spawns every even numbered floor.
 Added new doors and updated room palettes for blacksmith, shop and treasure rooms.
 Added fairy room/demon remon spawn chance stats. They are set to 0% for the time being.
 Giant statues have been added to the earth and air floor central rooms.
 Reduce the likelihood of some passive/active items to spawn more than once in the same run.
 Updated Astral room mini-map icon.
 Updated character select screen to show the weapon each character starts with. Rounded rectangles now border the weapon and active item.
 Updated character stats to use colors.
 From floor B5 onward, you will now take one full heart of damage per attack.

Fixes

 Fixed a bug where touching more than one downstairs tile at the same time would result in the player moving down multiple floors.
 Fixed a bug where Crystal Room progress is now correctly saved and loaded between runs. Dropping off a gemstone in the crystal room will update this progress.
 Fixed a bug where the Astral room's background was being palette swapped.


Thanks for reading and have a great day!
- Elias

notes.title: V0.3.8 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Hope your day is going well :)

Here's the new patch updates:


 Added the Astral room. The Astral room is a special room that you can reach by a teleporter. The teleporter has a rare chance of spawning when bombing a block such as a rock or statue. Currently the Astral room only contains coins and a teleporter back to the central room. In the future, it will hold more significance.
 Updated some options/stats menu text.
 Updated wizard weapon to be a wooden staff.
 Bonfires can be destroyed by weapons and bombs.
 Added game option to turn off particles.
 Added shadows underneath player/npc/enemy characters.
 Boss rooms spawn stairs to either a fairy fountain or demon room once cleared (50% each). These rooms will hold more significance in the future, but currently they just give you two hearts and mana stars each.
 Added stats (number of deaths, best streak, current streak). These stats persist when the game is
turned off. There are also some placeholder stats screens added for the bestiary, secrets, items unlocked and endings unlocked.
 Added a placeholder Challenges screen. In the future, you'll be able to play these unique challenges to unlock new things.
 Added passive items to game screen on the right side.
 Added player stats to the left side of screen.
 Player takes a full heart of damage on the water and wind floors.
 The temporary 24 passive item cap has been removed (inventory only shows up to 24). I put this into place before because the inventory screen only shows a max of 24 passive items currently. Now you can pick up any number of passive items. However! The inventory screen will only display 24 currently. In a future patch (hopefully next one!), you'll be able to view all your passive items.
 Added the crystal room (on floor B8). This room will have more significance in the future.
 Fixed a bug where blocks were not dropping pickups (except gold coins) or spawning downstairs like they were supposed to.


That's all for now. Have a great day!
- Elias

notes.title: V0.3.7.1 Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Hope your day is going well :)

First off, I just want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for purchasing Mystic Labyrinth. I'm a solo developer who has been working on the game since June of 2023. I have a full time job during the day, and I do work on Mystic Labyrinth in the evenings and weekends when I'm able. I've been so excited for the longest time to sell a video game. It's still hard for me to believe that this is happening. I wanted to put Mystic Labyrinth into Early Access so that I could start getting it into people's hands early on in development and incorporate feedback to make the game better.

Anywho, this is the first patch that I've done since launch. This update is V0.3.7.1. There's some quality of life stuff I wanted to put in for a time, but didn't get around to it. So for this update:


 You now have the ability to manually resize the window size with the mouse. The game will generally scale up when the window is larger. Black bars will be added to the sides at the edges of the game screen to preserve the game's aspect ratio.
 You can set the game to fullscreen.
 You can remap controls for your game pad if you have one connected. I use a nintendo pro switch controller for testing but a ps4 controller has also been tested with. Hopefully in the future I'll have more controllers to test with just to be safe.
 I've temporarily removed the fixed resolution options in the options menu. I was using these for testing before I implemented a solution to being able to resize the menu using the mouse cursor. I plan to put them back in in the next build with some common resolutions to make things easier if you want a specific resolution. It just didn't mesh exactly right in the code and I wanted to get this update out quickly, so I figured I would handle it next update.


That's it for now, it was just a small quality of life update. I'll be doing another update soon, but I expect the next one to be more focused on gameplay additions/improvements. I also plan to write a post in the near future about where I want Mystic Labyrinth to go from here. I've been thinking about making a roadmap for future content updates. I have an outline written out but I want to make a roadmap to make it compact and readable.

Until next time. Have a nice day!
- Elias
